html:
SMTO-BOOT-0016 — The model launcher doesn't recognize the engine you chose

GUID: e1b91035-2bc9-40c8-afb0-a4c329af4aec
Slug: boot-model-engine-unsupported
Domain: BOOT · Subsystem: boot

What happened

  • This launcher can run the model with one of two engines (the program that runs the model): vLLM or llama.cpp. The ENGINE setting names something else, so it stopped without starting anything.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Start the launcher with ENGINE set to vllm or llama.cpp, for example: ENGINE=llama.cpp ./src/vllm/start-mythos-9b-unhinged.sh These are the only two ways this launcher knows how to start the model.
  2. To use the default engine, vLLM, run unset ENGINE in your terminal, then start the launcher without ENGINE. When ENGINE isn't set, the launcher uses vLLM automatically, so a leftover value can't get in the way.
  3. Check the value for typos, capital letters or extra spaces, such as VLLM or llama-cpp with a dash. The launcher compares the name letter for letter and doesn't guess what you meant.

What success looks like

  • The launcher no longer shows this message and begins starting the vLLM or llama.cpp model server.

If it still fails

  • Copy the full terminal output, including the SMTO-BOOT-0016 line and the Error reference line, plus the exact command you ran, and send it to the person who manages your model setup. Don't keep rerunning with the same ENGINE value; it will stop the same way.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • start-mythos-9b-unhinged.sh exited with status 2 because ENGINE is not one of vllm, llama.cpp, llama_cpp, llama or gguf, so neither launch path ran.

What this means

  • Model launcher dispatch finds ENGINE outside its recognized engine branches. The Mythos launcher rejects the engine before entering either engine-specific launch path. An accepted engine name does not establish that its dependencies, model files or GPUs are ready.

Why this can happen

  • Model launcher dispatch finds ENGINE outside its recognized engine branches.

How to diagnose it

  • Inspect the exact ENGINE value and this script's accepted choices.

How to fix it

  • Set ENGINE=vllm (the default when ENGINE is unset or empty) or ENGINE=llama.cpp (aliases llama_cpp, llama, gguf); the match is exact and case-sensitive. A recognized engine only selects the launch path; vLLM in PYTHON_BIN or LLAMA_SERVER_BIN, the model files and the GPUs are checked afterwards.
  • Choose ENGINE=vllm or ENGINE=llama.cpp for this launcher.

Retry and execution caution

  • Select ENGINE=vllm or ENGINE=llama.cpp, then run the matching engine preflight.

How to verify the fix

  • A supported vllm or llama.cpp selection reaches its intended launch path.

What not to do

  • Do not repeatedly submit the same invalid input; correct the named constraint first.

Technical notes

  • The Mythos launcher rejects the engine before entering either engine-specific launch path.
  • An accepted engine name does not establish that its dependencies, model files or GPUs are ready.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
